pattern: SVG chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription) of role="img" data points with roving focus; data table fallback (native table). Follows the WAI Complex Images tutorial (short name plus long description) and the roving tabindex technique of WAI-ARIA APG.

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription (localized chart type), named by the title
img with an aria-label: category/x, series, formatted value
list (ul) named "Legend"; entries are toggle buttons (aria-pressed)
group named "Zoom" of native buttons "Zoom in", "Zoom out", "Reset zoom"
table (native) with caption, column headers, and row headers; wide tables scroll in a focusable region

roles.element: axes, lines, textures, value labels, tooltip, crosshair, selection brush
roles.role: aria-hidden (decorative duplicates of the accessible data)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id
Localized chart type, for example "line chart"
0 on exactly one mark (roving); other marks have none
true while the series is visible
Table open state and the table region id
true while the action is unavailable (Zoom in at the minimum span, Zoom out and Reset zoom when not zoomed); the button stays focusable

keyboard.action: Previous / next data point (category) in the same series; Left/Right are mirrored in RTL. Zoomed: moving past the window edge pans the window to the next point.

keyboard.context: Mark focused, more than one visible series
keyboard.action: Same category in the previous / next visible series (nearest point when missing).
First / last point of the series.
Zoom in around the focused x value.
Zoom out around the focused x value.
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
Zoom buttons (zoom: true), legend buttons, then one tab stop for the plot (the active mark), then the Show data table button and table region.
Shows or hides the series (native button).
Zoom in, zoom out, or reset (native button; ignored while aria-disabled).

focus: Roving focus: one mark is in the tab sequence and remembers the last visited data point, also across re-renders (resize, update). Toggling a legend entry keeps focus on its button; toggling the table keeps focus on the table button.
notes: The generated summary lists the chart type, series and point counts, axis ranges, per-series minimum and maximum with their positions, the overall trend, missing values, and hidden series.
Meaning never depends on color alone: marker shapes, dash patterns, and textures (patterns option), plus legend keys that repeat them.
Forced colors: series use CanvasText and keep shapes, dashes, and textures; focus uses Highlight.
No animation: nothing moves on render; hover and focus emphasis transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion and animation: none.

Series with more than 600 visible points in total use two proxy marks instead of one node per point; focus alternates between them so every move is announced. Browse-mode users read the exact values from the data table.

Zoom changes are announced politely ("Showing {from} to {to}." or "Showing all data.") and emitted as aui-zoom. Pointer-only gestures (Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, drag pan, Shift + drag selection) all have keyboard and toolbar equivalents.
The crosshair (crosshair option) is aria-hidden and follows both hover and keyboard focus; it hides when focus and the pointer leave.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
aria-roledescription support varies; screen readers without it announce "group".
